prompts.text:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent sprite WALK ANIMATION SHEET for a medieval dark-apocalypse 2.5D game.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE, not an output layout. Use ONLY its four monster identities: gaunt undead (reference row2 col3), armored corrupted raider (row2 col4), horned plague boss (row3 col1), mutated gray-hooded player with huge exposed bony claw arm (row3 col2).
Produce ONE exact 6 COLUMNS by 4 ROWS regular grid, 24 complete isolated character poses total. Canvas preferred 1536 x 1024, six 256px-square cells per row. NO cell borders, labels, shadows, floor or background: true transparent alpha everywhere outside each silhouette.
Rows in order from top to bottom: 1 gaunt undead with ragged brown skirt and gray emaciated limbs; 2 corrupted raider in rusty battered armor and ragged fur cloak holding his axe; 3 massive horned plague boss, decayed skin, brass shoulder armor and tattered robe; 4 gray hooded corrupted human player, layered dark leather, red eyes, greatly enlarged pale bony left claw.
Each row is the SAME character walking IN PLACE, constant identity, equipment, height, camera, scale, position, lighting and three-quarter RIGHT-FACING orientation in all six frames. Keep realistic original proportions, worn textured materials, restrained original colors and soft neutral lighting. Face/nose points screen-right with chest partly visible. Do NOT turn toward viewer or change direction during cycle.
Six sequential visibly DIFFERENT full-body locomotion poses left to right: frame 1 right leg forward heel contact and left leg back; frame 2 right foot planted knee bent, left foot starts to lift; frame 3 left knee passes forward beside right support leg; frame 4 left leg forward heel contact and right leg back; frame 5 left foot planted knee bent, right foot starts to lift; frame 6 right knee passes forward beside left support leg, leading seamlessly back to frame1. Arms counter-swing naturally with legs, cloak hems move with legs, torso remains nearly level. Right and left legs MUST visibly alternate, feet MUST occupy different positions each frame. Not six duplicate poses, not merely translating or bouncing a static image.
Registration requirement: every cell has the character root at 50% cell width, planted-foot sole baseline at 88% cell height, head/highest horns near 12% cell height. Same row head height and feet baseline constant between frames; limbs may move inside cell but root does not. Full silhouettes entirely inside each cell with at least 8% transparent padding on ALL sides including horns, axe blade and claw. No overlapping adjacent cells. Keep boss within same padded cell bounds and let game scale it larger later.
No idle poses, attacks, magic, trails, bloom, particles, lettering, numbers, watermark, grid lines, checkerboard or ground shadows. The output must be a game-ready transparent sprite sheet of 24 distinct WALK poses.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this supplied transparent 6x4 monster walk sprite sheet. Keep all 24 sprites, the SAME characters, six distinct sequential walk poses per row, exact worn realistic style, same equipment, same lighting, same right-facing camera. Keep transparent background.
ONLY fix the sprite layout to make this safe for uniform atlas slicing: canvas EXACTLY 1536x1024, six columns each256px and four rows each256px. Every cell is independent. Scale each complete silhouette DOWN so that it fits inside its own cell, with at least 24px CLEAR TRANSPARENT SPACE from left/right cell edges and at least28px above the head/horns and below the lowest foot/weapon. No silhouette may cross cell boundaries.
This is crucial for the broad horned boss (row3) and axe raider(row2): reduce their size until horns, arms, axes and feet are fully contained. Keep all frames in EACH ROW the same body scale, root at cell center x128, lowest planted-foot baseline at local y224, head/horns near local y36. Do not scale each pose individually. Anchor the feet at the same baseline in every frame. Do not introduce variable scale or horizontal drift.
Preserve the visibly different gait poses in all six columns: alternating forward/back legs, lifted passing knee, bent support knee and opposing arm swing. No duplicates, no interpolation blur. Frame1 rightleg forward,2down,3passing;4leftlegforward,5down,6passing. No shadows, effects, backgrounds, text, cell borders, guides or labels. Real alpha transparency, no grid. Output the corrected production atlas, not an explanation.

Create a transparent RPG animation atlas. The first reference gives the FOUR MONSTER IDENTITIES and their look only; the second gives their six walking poses.
Critical visible change from the second reference: SHRINK ALL MONSTERS TO 65% OF THEIR CURRENT SIZE within the same atlas, preserving their internal proportions. There must be very LARGE EMPTY TRANSPARENT GAPS around every complete character, like isolated small miniatures. The previous arrangement was too tightly packed. This new atlas must be visibly much less crowded.
Exact grid: SIX columns and FOUR rows. 24 separate miniatures. 1536x1024 canvas. Each cell is256x256. The character must fit inside the central 164x164 area of its cell, leaving46 pixels of transparent space on EACH side. In every cell, midpoint of both planted feet is at x128,y210. Highest head/horn y46 or lower. Nobody crosses a cell boundary. All frames in a row have equal body scale. Boss is smaller here so its wide horns and arms fit; runtime will scale it larger. No gridlines or cell labels.
Row1: gaunt undead gray skeletal man with raggedbrown skirt. Row2: armoredcorrupted raider with rustyplate, furcloak andaxe. Row3: massive hornedplagueboss brassshoulderarmor, skeletalface, longclaw arms andtatteredrobe. Row4: corruptedgrayhoodedplayer withred eyes andhuge exposedbonyclaw leftarm.
All face toward screen RIGHT in fixed three-quarter view. Six consecutive DISTINCT WALK cycle phases across EACH row: rightfoot forward heelcontact; rightfoot planted kneecompressed leftfootlifting; leftknee passingright supportleg; leftfoot forwardheelcontact; leftfoot plantedkneecompressed rightfootlifting; rightkneepassingleftsupportleg. Arms counter-swing, cloak follows. Same body height andposition, not duplicated poses, not floating, no turning.
Match original material textures and realistic anatomy; keep same character per row. Pure transparent background, no shadows, no floor, no effects, no text, no numbers, no border, no checkerboard. Only 24 complete small fully contained animated monster sprites with huge transparent padding.
